absent_reason: analysis_set: No held source explicitly identifies the analysis population for registry outcome 1 as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, safety, or all randomised; its POPULATION field is empty. Matching denominators do not establish ITT.
served_mismatch: The served HR, CI, counts and timeframe match registry outcome 1. The served intention-to-treat designation is not explicitly supported by the held sources. The bound effect is an HR, whereas served_outcome.estimand requests RR.

candidate_rejections.why: This primary composite additionally includes urgent visits for heart failure; it is not the served secondary composite.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 2 ANALYSIS 0: groups Placebo | Rate Ratio (RR) 0.75 (95% CI 0.65 to 0.88)
candidate_rejections.why: This estimates recurrent hospitalizations and cardiovascular death using a rate ratio, a different endpoint and effect measure.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Eligibility specifies adults with symptomatic HFrEF and LVEF ≤40%; the held full text also explicitly describes a double-blind placebo-controlled randomized trial.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Male or female, aged ≥18 years * Established documented diagnosis of symptomatic HFrEF (NYHA functional class II-IV), which has been present for at least 2 months * LVEF≤40%

notes: Registry spans are accepted for the exact served endpoint, effect, CI and timeframe. Full-text entry criteria describe the parent trial, not the biomarker subset. BOUND does not establish the unstated analysis set or convert HR to RR.
